credit: Height: NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (NCD-RisC), A century of trends in adult human height, eLife 2016 (CC BY 4.0). Estimates from ncdrisc.org, rounded to 0.1 cm, every second birth year.
basis: Modelled mean height at age 18 of people born in a given year (1896-1996, every second year), in cm, with the 95% credible interval. Not current measurements: the latest cohort turned 18 in 2014. Only 72 of the 200 countries have any measurements of people born in 1920 or earlier, and 134 of people born 1921-1945; elsewhere, early values come mostly from the model. NCD-RisC now lists this adult release among its archived estimates; its newer height release (Lancet 2020) covers ages 5-19 only.
studies: Number of measurement studies with data for each sex (eLife 2016, Supplementary file 3). 0 means no measured data for that sex in this country; the estimate is borrowed from other countries' data, mostly from the same region.
